niche_preference_profile: This user prefers clean, airy, modern UI screens that feel finished, structured, and task-focused. They consistently like clear hierarchy, visible section grouping, balanced spacing, and enough content density to feel useful without becoming crowded. They favor direct, specific labels and copy, prominent but not overly aggressive controls, and polished card/list styling. They generally reject clutter, oversized hero imagery, vague copy, weak hierarchy, unfinished-looking empty states, and overly alarmist or promotional presentation.

criteria.description: Clear title, strong section emphasis, and distinct separation between content blocks so the screen is easy to scan.
A layout that feels populated and useful, with enough visible options and content to avoid emptiness, but not so much that it feels crowded.
A coherent, complete-looking interface with no blank, unfinished, or prototype-like areas.
Concise, specific, benefit-led, and task-oriented microcopy that explains what the screen is for without sounding generic or promotional.
Controls that are obvious and easy to understand, with visible toggles, chevrons, or buttons that match the action type.
Content organized into clearly labeled sections or cards that make categories and settings relationships immediately understandable.
A screen that avoids unnecessary decorative elements, excessive empty space, and visual noise while still feeling breathable.
Setting names and headings that are concrete and user-friendly rather than vague, generic, or overly technical.
Clean, modern styling with restrained decoration, soft accents, and a premium feel rather than heavy, dated, or overly saturated visuals.
Primary actions that are clearly visible and well-anchored, but not overly loud, alarming, or visually dominant.
